data.description:
## Context / Problem
T13 (1,939 agentic runs), T14 (1,939), removal-rationale (1,722), and asserted-capability (409) have produced zero findings ever — ~7,900 wasted agentic executions. An adversarial false-negative audit amended the initially proposed triggers: T13 needed mechanism-of-enforcement vocabulary ("exits nonzero", "turns the run red", bare gate/hook — 176 real gate-vocab tickets missed by the draft); T14 needed a structured file_impact condition (.github/, Makefile, hooks/, *.yml, pyproject.toml — 82 CI-evidence tickets missed) plus scheduler/release vocabulary; removal-rationale needed disable/bypass/skip/supersede weakening vocabulary (99 missed tickets); asserted-capability had two outright regex bugs (exists? not matching "existing"; bare snake_case symbols failing the module-ref leg). Amended fire rates: 84.0% / 61.6% / 86.5% / 96.5%.

## Approach
Add the four amended triggers as deterministic pre-gates in src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py alongside _DET_OVERLAY_RULES (registry.py:452-457): a not-fired trigger skips the criterion with an explicit coverage entry recording the skip; a fired trigger routes to the LLM exactly as today. T14 and removal-rationale each carry a structured OR-condition over file_impact (path patterns; declared deletions) evaluated before the text regex. The criteria stay in the registry and rubrics are untouched — this is gating, not removal. The exact amended regexes are recorded in the audit on ticket 696a and are transcribed verbatim into the rules. Alternative rejected: retiring the criteria — operator ruled they must remain; and narrow original regexes — the audit demonstrated realistic evasion classes for each.

## Scope
src/rebar/llm/plan_review/registry.py, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json (trigger annotations), tests/llm/test_det_criterion_gates.py.

## Testing
Unit: every evasion sentence from the audit fires its trigger (parameterized over the recorded sentence lists); minimal non-matching plans skip each criterion with a coverage record; the file_impact OR-conditions fire on a .github/workflows path and a declared deletion respectively; fired plans route the criterion unchanged.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All audit evasion sentences fire their respective triggers (checked: parameterized unit test embedding the audit sentence lists).
- [ ] A plan not firing a trigger skips that criterion with zero LLM calls and a coverage skip entry naming the trigger (checked: unit test with FakeRunner).
- [ ] file_impact OR-conditions fire T14 on .github/workflows paths and removal-rationale on declared deletions regardless of description text (checked: unit tests).
- [ ] Fired plans run the criterion exactly as before (checked: existing routing tests pass).
data.title: Deterministic pre-gates for the four zero-finding AGENT criteria
